As a step in fixing diamonds related to reals, complexes, and RCLike stuff, I tried in #38315 to make RingHom.comp implicit-reducible as it shows everywhere in these instances (in the algebra structures). To test your intuition, can you guess how bad the performance impact is on Mathlib?

Spoiler

this gives a 0.08% improvement, i.e., -136.9G
That's nice! But to really get the effect we want, we also need the nested definitions to be made implicit_reducible, e.g. NonUnitalRingHom.comp.

The definition of RingHom.comp is toFun = ... with ..., so with the reducible RingHom.comp it looks into the toFun, and the rest is just proofs that it can ignore. So it will never look into the intermediate classes.
